Answer: F
Reason: The lateral chest X-ray (Figure 1) shows a mass in the posterior aspect of the right hemithorax. The axial CT scans (Figures 2 and 3) confirm a large, lobulated soft tissue mass in the posterior right hemithorax associated with a pleural effusion, but without obvious diffuse pleural thickening or nodules typical of classic malignant mesothelioma. This presentation is consistent with a less typical form of malignant mesothelioma or another pleural-based malignancy.
